items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: And I can remember Rene and they had Guy Kelly during that time. I think he was playing on the truck.

ctx.x: And I can remember Rene and they had Guy Kelly during that time. I think he was playing on the truck. I know Punch was around. Georgie Boy, because he stayed about three or four doors for me.
